reason: After a request-boundary rejection, the executable except branch increments the worker number and falls through to the outer worker loop with the unchanged archive and scope. That submits another worker without a newly validated request.

After repair-handshake wait returns _repair_terminal, the executable branch persists the terminal and continues to the outer worker loop, replaying the same worker rather than taking a typed disposition.

requirements: Preserve the verified local hashes, exact claim, initial consumed-repair adoption, worker-3 entry, post-worker retrieval, and scientific identities.

Use an inner request-dispatch loop after every recoverable worker result. A new worker may start only after one request is atomically consumed and its patch is validated against the current diagnostic, claim generation, and retry scope.

On a rejected request, persist a fresh hash-bound diagnostic and continue heartbeating inside the request-dispatch loop. Do not increment the worker generation, change archive or scope, or execute a worker until a later valid request is consumed.

Interpret repair_terminal as a typed disposition and do not execute another worker from it. Release generation-fenced to maintenance unless the terminal proves a validated scientific terminal already handled by the scientific-terminal branch.

Offline-validate the executable branch after repair-handshake wait for valid request, rejected request, repair_terminal, and deadline responses.
